description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractErrorResponse that implements ErrorResponse interface, serves as a base for error response objects within the Ditto signals commands. It contains constructors and a static method to build exceptions from JSON payloads.

classes.name: AbstractErrorResponse
classes.description: An abstract base class for error responses in the Ditto signals command framework, providing common functionality for error handling.

methods.name: AbstractErrorResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing the error response with response type, status code, and headers.

methods.name: buildExceptionFromJson
methods.description: Static method to parse a JsonObject payload into a DittoRuntimeException, with fallback to generate a generic exception if parsing fails.
